card.name: Words leading into a kingdom name
card.fires_on: Small words like 'of', 'in' or 'founded' in historical text right before the name of a kingdom or ruler's realm is expected, often in Asian ancient history.

modes.label: 'of' after kingdom or king
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'Kingdom', 'King' or 'capital', before a realm's name.
modes.example: Oc Eo culture is a common name of the civilization of the legendary Kingdom<< of>> Funan in the southern region.

modes.label: Verbs and modifiers before a realm
modes.description: Words like 'founded', 'native' or 'legendary' that come just before a kingdom or ruler is named.
modes.example: by 849, had<< founded>> a powerful kingdom centered on Bagan.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'kingdom' or 'king' next.
card.plain: It fires on little words in ancient-history text when a kingdom or king is about to be mentioned.
